entities.name: Salif Traoré
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: General Salif Traoré is a Malian politician. He graduated from the École spéciale militaire de Saint-Cyr. He has served as the Malian Minister of Security & Civilian Protection since September 2015. He believes in combatting terrorism by collecting better intelligence.

entities.name: Salif Traoré
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: General Salif Traoré is a Malian politician. He graduated from the École spéciale militaire de Saint-Cyr. He has served as the Malian Minister of Security & Civilian Protection since September 2015. He believes in combatting terrorism by collecting better intelligence.
